policyRef: ILLUSTRATIVE — 'SME FINANCE SAR RAG' and 'TAWRROUQ' are riyal products in Tuum's partners sandbox (adapters/tuum/README.md, 2026-10-08) that belong to another partner's test set; the institution's own products replace them. The Admin catalogue's core product code, when set, takes precedence over this file.
